title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 13
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The DGMS stands for
questions.solution: Directorate General of Mine Safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine rescue team must respond to an emergency within
options: Within one hour of the call
At any time of the day
As quickly as possible, typically within 15-30 minutes
questions.solution: As quickly as possible, typically within 15-30 minutes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'withdrawal of supports' during depillaring follows
options: Specific sequence to ensure worker safety
questions.solution: Support withdrawal follows specific safety sequences.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, the manager must report a fatal accident to
questions.solution: The Chief Inspector must be notified within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be equipped with
options: Communication system between top and bottom
questions.solution: A communication system between top and bottom is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'safety violation report' must include
options: Nature of violation, person(s) involved, section of regulation violated, and action taken
questions.solution: Nature, person, regulation, and action taken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A lighting arrestor is used in mines to
options: Divert lightning surges to earth and safeguard the circuits
questions.solution: Protects electrical equipment from lightning surges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A junction box in a mine must be
options: Flameproof or intrinsically safe as per the zone classification
questions.solution: Flameproof or intrinsically safe per zone classification.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sirdar must not leave his section without
options: Proper handover to another authorized person
The permission of the workers' union
questions.solution: Proper handover to another authorized person is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety culture' in a mine refers to
options: Shared values, attitudes, and behaviors regarding safety
questions.solution: Shared values, attitudes, and behaviors regarding safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal basin' is a
questions.solution: A coal basin is a large depression with coal deposits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shot firing' sequence in underground coal mines follows
options: Specific sequence to ensure safety and fragmentation
questions.solution: Shot firing follows specific sequence for safety and fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine must have a
questions.solution: A recording device to log operations is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rope speed indicator' must be
options: Clearly visible and accurate to within prescribed limits
questions.solution: Clearly visible and accurate within prescribed limits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must be provided with a
options: Device to prevent the cage from overwinding
questions.solution: A device to prevent overwinding is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing emergency procedures' address
options: Pipeline bursts, dam failures, and flooding incidents
questions.solution: Emergency procedures cover pipeline bursts, dam failures, and flooding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal reserve' estimation considers
options: Seam thickness, quality, and economic viability
questions.solution: Reserve estimation considers thickness, quality, and economics.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'power to prohibit employment' in a mine lies with
options: The inspector of mines or the Chief Inspector
questions.solution: The inspector of mines or the Chief Inspector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast pattern' in opencast mines is designed considering
options: Rock type, explosive, and desired fragmentation
questions.solution: Blast patterns consider geology, explosives, and fragmentation goals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The earth wire in electrical installation is used to
options: Provide a low resistance path for fault current to earth
questions.solution: Provides a low resistance path for fault current to earth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: LHD stands for
questions.solution: LHD stands for Load Haul Dump.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'offences and penalties' under the Mines Act include
options: A written warning in the register
A verbal warning to the manager
Fines, imprisonment, or both for contravention of provisions
questions.solution: Fines, imprisonment, or both for contravention.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A competent electrical supervisor in a mine is responsible for
options: Supervision, maintenance, and safety of all electrical installations
questions.solution: Supervision, maintenance, and safety of all electrical installations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal seam splitting' occurs when
options: A single seam divides into two or more seams
questions.solution: Seam splitting occurs when one seam divides into multiple.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overbreak' in drifting is
options: Excavation beyond the designed drift profile
questions.solution: Overbreak is excavation beyond the designed profile.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sub-drilling' in blast holes is done to
options: Ensure breakage at planned floor level
questions.solution: Sub-drilling ensures proper breakage at the planned floor level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stowing materials include
options: Sand, fly ash, stone dust, and other mine waste
questions.solution: Sand, fly ash, stone dust, and other mine waste.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'firing order' in a blast is important to
options: Control the direction of throw and minimize vibration
To decide the number of persons in the mine
questions.solution: Controls direction of throw and vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'truss bolting' in underground mines uses
options: Bolts connected in a truss configuration for wide span support
questions.solution: Truss bolting connects bolts in truss configuration for wide spans.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar should check that all persons under his charge
questions.solution: All persons must be wearing required PPE.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the sirdar must not permit
questions.solution: The sirdar must not permit any work he thinks unsafe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas content' of coal depends on
options: Coal rank, depth, and geological history
questions.solution: Gas content depends on rank, depth, and geological history.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An explosive charge is used in face drilling to
options: Fragment coal or rock for easier loading
questions.solution: Fragments coal or rock for easier loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'peak particle velocity' (PPV) is a measure of
questions.solution: PPV measures maximum ground vibration velocity from blasting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's duty during blasting includes
options: Ensuring all persons are removed to a safe distance
questions.solution: During blasting the sirdar must ensure all persons are at a safe distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cable bolt' in mining is used for
options: Deep support in weak roof conditions
questions.solution: Cable bolts provide deep support in weak roof conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'Inspector of Mines' is appointed by
options: The Central Government or State Government
questions.solution: Appointed by the Central Government or State Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal dust explosion is one of the most dangerous hazards in
questions.solution: Coal dust explosion is most dangerous in underground coal mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The color code for electrical cables in mines helps to

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'power to make rules' lies with
questions.solution: The Central Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'manriding' in underground mines uses
questions.solution: Manriding uses special transport systems for worker movement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'advancing longwall' method involves
options: Extracting coal from the boundary towards the shaft
Extracting coal from the shaft area towards the boundary
questions.solution: Extracting coal from shaft area towards boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'hanging shot' in coal mines is fired when
options: The coal face is vertical or overhanging
questions.solution: Hanging shots are used when coal face is vertical or overhanging.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar shall ensure that no person works
options: Under the influence of intoxicating substance
questions.solution: No person shall work under the influence of intoxicating substance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'anemometer' is used to measure
questions.solution: Measures air velocity in mine roadways.

questions.stem: The minimum incombustible content in stone dust barriers must be
questions.solution: Minimum 75% incombustible content is required.

questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that safety lamps are

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'spontaneous combustion' of coal occurs due to
options: Coal reacting with oxygen and generating heat
questions.solution: Spontaneous combustion occurs when coal reacts with oxygen.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The dust control plan in a mine must include
options: Only the watering of the office garden
A one-time painting of the buildings
Methods of suppression, monitoring, and review
questions.solution: Methods of suppression, monitoring, and review.

questions.stem: The 'extensometer' in mining is used to measure
options: The air velocity in the roadway
questions.solution: Extensometers measure displacement or convergence of roof and floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'historical workings' data is important for inundation risk because
options: It shows the age of the mine
It shows old workings that may be water-logged
questions.solution: Shows old workings that may be water-logged.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'corrective action report' should specify
options: What was done, who did it, when it was done, and the result
questions.solution: What, who, when, and result.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of persons in a man riding car at any time must not exceed
questions.solution: Must not exceed designed safe capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'steel prop' in underground mines is preferred over timber because
options: It's adjustable, reusable, and has higher capacity
questions.solution: Steel props are adjustable, reusable, and have higher load capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety slogan 'Safety is no accident' emphasizes that
options: Safety requires deliberate effort and planning
questions.solution: Safety requires deliberate effort and planning.

questions.stem: The 'strike' of a coal seam refers to
options: Direction of the line of intersection with horizontal
questions.solution: Strike is the direction of the horizontal line on the seam.

questions.stem: The maximum permissible FER for shot firing in coal mines is

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'trim blast' in mining is used to
options: Create smooth final wall with minimal damage
questions.solution: Trim blasts create smooth final walls with minimal damage.

questions.stem: Stowing difficulties include

questions.solution: Pipeline blockages, uneven fill, and water management issues.

questions.solution: Ensures reliability, safety, and productivity.

questions.solution: At intervals prescribed by the manager.

options: Ensuring correct alignment, level, and position of workings
questions.solution: Ensures correct alignment, level, and position of workings.

options: Maintained in prescribed format and preserved
questions.solution: Survey records must be maintained and preserved.

questions.solution: Must not be used if it affects the safety of persons.

Rated for the normal inflow only

questions.stem: The sirdar is responsible for ensuring that
options: Only after the work is completed
Proper support is set before work proceeds
questions.solution: Proper support must be set before work proceeds.

questions.stem: The sirdar must check the working place for gas using
options: A flame safety lamp and/or gas detector
questions.solution: Gas detection requires a flame safety lamp and/or gas detector.

questions.stem: A 'non-electric detonator' or 'shock tube' system is used because
options: It is safer near electrical equipment and lightning
questions.solution: Safer near electrical equipment and lightning.

questions.stem: The 'break-even strip ratio' means

questions.solution: Swell factor accounts for increased volume after excavation.

questions.stem: The 'priming' of an explosive charge involves

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing environmental monitoring' includes
options: Water quality, surface stability, and dust levels
Only the colour of the sand

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be examined
questions.solution: Daily examination before use is mandatory.

questions.stem: The 'powder factor' in coal mine blasting is expressed as
